items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: We had a female vocalist, Edith Wright, and they left at the same time -- and Jack Leonard.

ctx.x: Just wanted to clarify that. Was who?
We had a female vocalist, Edith Wright, and they left at the same time -- and Jack Leonard.
You were with Tommy Dorsey's band with Charlie Shavers.
